pass_criteria: sparse warm yellow-green glow points on near-black
brightness variation across the population (some dim, some bright = blink feel)

prior_iterations.critique: Wandering float (no directional lean between t1/t4), population brightness variation (bright/dim mix = blink feel), and soft-edged glow points all read. Two degree-misses: color is green-dominant and slightly cold where 暖黄绿 was asked (fireflies want warmer chartreuse), and steady-state density at t4 (~70 points) drifts toward starfield — the sparse countable-fireflies read of t1 is better.
